selection.rule: Dependency-complete first 24 questions from the question-sheet selection order.

questions.question: According to the passage, what three things help show the worth and excellence of any speech?
questions.answer: Its source, its audience, and its purpose.

questions.question: Why is this idea important for understanding the Qur’an?
questions.answer: Because once those three matters are considered, the Qur’an’s superiority becomes evident.

questions.question: What answer does the passage give to the question of the Qur’an’s purpose?
questions.answer: To explain the path to success in both worlds, the outcomes of creation, and the divine wisdom in the universe.

questions.question: What makes that recipient especially significant in the passage?
questions.answer: He is presented as the most honored and well-known of people, with a faith so vast and powerful that it gave rise to Islam and brought him to a very high nearness to Allah.

questions.question: What did that immense faith lead to in the world?
questions.answer: It gave rise to the powerful reality of Islam.

questions.question: How does the Qur’an deal with the universe in the passage?
questions.answer: It turns toward the whole universe, displays it from every angle, and explains it clearly.

questions.question: What conclusion does the passage draw from the Qur’an’s source, audience, and subject matter?
questions.answer: That producing anything equal to it is impossible and its miraculous rank cannot be reached.

questions.question: What kind of scholarly response has the Qur’an received?
questions.answer: It has received careful and extensive study from many highly intelligent scholars.

questions.question: What basic principle about speech is stated at the beginning of the passage?
questions.answer: The greatness of speech becomes clear when we know who spoke it, who receives it, and why it was spoken.

questions.question: How does the passage apply that principle to the Qur’an?
questions.answer: It presents all three elements at the highest level, which proves the Qur’an cannot be rivaled.

questions.question: What feature of the Qur’an’s delivery separates it from ordinary human speech?
questions.answer: It lacks any trace of copied style or made-up display.

questions.question: Why does the passage mention the Prophet’s high spiritual station?
questions.answer: To show the nobility of the one receiving the Qur’an and thereby the greatness of the speech addressed to him.

questions.question: What outcomes of the Qur’an are connected to human well-being?
questions.answer: It teaches what brings happiness and success in both worldly life and the hereafter.

questions.question: How is the Prophet’s belief described in relation to Islamic truth?
questions.answer: As the loftiest and most inclusive belief, containing all Islamic truths.

questions.question: Why is it significant that the Qur’an explains the universe as its Maker would?
questions.answer: Because that implies complete knowledge and authority, which human speech cannot match.

questions.question: What conclusion follows from this description of the Qur’an?
questions.answer: That no one can produce its equal and its miraculous level cannot be reached.

questions.question: What three questions should be asked to judge the quality of a statement, according to the passage?
questions.answer: Who said it, who it is directed to, and what purpose it serves.

questions.question: How is the speaker of the Qur’an described?
questions.answer: As the Sustainer of all worlds and the Creator of the entire universe.

questions.question: How does the passage rule out the idea that the Qur’an is merely human expression?
questions.answer: It describes it as free from signs of imitation or artificial construction.

questions.question: Why is the Prophet’s fame and honor mentioned in this argument?
questions.answer: Because the greatness of the one addressed helps show the greatness of the message given to him.

questions.question: How does the passage present the belief of the Messenger?
questions.answer: As the highest and widest form of belief, carrying all the truths of Islam.

questions.question: What does the passage say about the scope of the Prophet’s belief?
questions.answer: It was broad enough to carry all the truths of Islam.

questions.question: Why does the passage conclude that no one can produce something equal to the Qur’an?
questions.answer: Because no human can speak with the authority, scope, and perfect knowledge described there.

questions.question: How is the depth of Qur’anic study illustrated in the passage?
questions.answer: By mentioning commentaries that span many volumes.
